items.text: \operatorname{Hom}(K[T],K')=K',\qquad \operatorname{Hom}(K[T,T^{-1}],K')=K'^{*}\subset K'
The universal point
$X=V_A$. Universal point: $x_0\in X(K'_0)$ such that every $x\in X(K')$ comes from $x_0$ by a unique homomorphism $K'_0\to K'$.
K'_0=A,\qquad x_0=\mathrm{id}_A\in X(A)=\operatorname{Hom}_{K\text{-alg}}(A,A)
Closed algebraic subspaces of an affine algebraic space
$X=V_{P_I/J}\subset E^I$; $Y=V_{\mathfrak K}\subset X$ iff $\mathfrak K\supset J$: ideals $\mathfrak a$ of $A=P_I/J$.
Y(K')=\{x\in\operatorname{Hom}_{K\text{-alg}}(A,K') : x|_{\mathfrak a}=0\}\ \subset X(K')
\mathfrak a=\{f\in A : f(x)=0\ \ \forall K',\ \forall x\in Y(K')\},\qquad f(x)=x(f)
Ideals, not radical ideals: $K'$ arbitrary (neither fields, domains nor reduced rings).
Flatness tested on algebras (idealization)
$M$ a $K$-module such that $M\otimes K'\to M\otimes K''$ is injective for every injective algebra map $K'\to K''$. Then $M$ is flat.
D_K(N)=K\times N,\qquad (\lambda,x)(\lambda',x')=(\lambda\lambda',\ \lambda x'+\lambda'x)\qquad(N^2=0)
N'\hookrightarrow N''\ \Rightarrow\ D_K(N')\hookrightarrow D_K(N'')\ \Rightarrow\ M\oplus(M\otimes N')\hookrightarrow M\oplus(M\otimes N'')
Sums of affine algebraic spaces
X=\coprod_iX_i\ \ \text{(finite)}\ \leftrightarrow\ A=\prod_iA_i,\qquad X_i=V_{A_i}
$X_i\to X$ is a closed immersion ($A\to A_i$ is surjective).
\coprod_iX_i(K')\ \longrightarrow\ X(K')\qquad\text{injective; is it bijective?}
Connectedness
$X$ is connected if $X=X'\sqcup X''$ implies $X'$ or $X''$ is an initial object.
V_0\colon K'\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}(0,K')=\begin{cases}\mathrm{pt}& K'=0\\ \varnothing& K'\neq0\end{cases}\qquad(\text{the empty affine algebraic space})
$X=V_A$ is connected iff $A$ is not a product $A'\times A''$ of two nonzero rings.
A=A'\times A''\ \leftrightarrow\ e',e''\in A:\quad e'^2=e',\ e''^2=e'',\ e'e''=0,\ e'+e''=1
